intent.goal: Write an audit log entry with event "session.expired" whenever a login request (`handleLogin` in src/auth/login.ts) arrives with an expired session. The response must still be the `expired` response.

Count each request that arrives with an expired session against the client's rate limit (`guardRequest` in src/auth/rate-limit.ts), so a client replaying an expired token is eventually turned away. Valid sessions and requests without a session must not be counted.
Make `verifySession` in src/auth/session.ts return null for an expired session instead of throwing, so callers can treat 'no session' uniformly. Keep the signature unchanged.
Add an `x-session-ttl` header to authenticated responses (`withSessionHeaders` in src/api/responses.ts): the whole seconds left before the session expires.
